```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
tidyverse_packages()

read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")

penguins <- read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")
```


```{r}
penguins |> count()
penguins |> count(island) |> arrange(n)
```


```{r}
penguins |> arrange()
penguins |> arrange(flipper_len)
```


```{r}
penguins |> relocate(year, .after = island) |> head()
```


```{r}
# Task 1
penguins |> arrange(body_mass) |> relocate(body_mass, .after = island) |> head()

# Task 2
penguins |> arrange(desc(flipper_len)) |> relocate(flipper_len, .after = island) |> head()

# Task 3
penguins |> group_by(species) |> arrange(bill_len) |> relocate(bill_len, .after = island)
## alt. solution (slide 12)
penguins |> arrange(species, desc(bill_len))

# Task 4
penguins |> relocate(bill_dep, bill_len, flipper_len, body_mass, .after =species)

# Task 5
penguins |> relocate(year, .after = sex)

# Challenge
penguins |> arrange(desc(body_mass)) |> relocate(body_mass, bill_dep, bill_len, flipper_len, .before = species)
```


```{r}
# Task No. 1 - Filter Adelie penguins

penguins |> filter(species == "Adelie") |> count()

# Task No. 2 - Which Island has most penguins
penguins |> count(island)

#Task No. 3 - Display all Gentoo Penguins which have a body mass greater than 5.000 g
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & body_mass > 5000) |> relocate(body_mass, .after = island)

#Task No. 4 - For how many penguins do we have sex data
penguins |> filter(sex > 0) |> count()

#Task No. 5 - I define a small penguin as weighing less than 3500g and having a bill shorter than 35mm. How many penguins meet this criteria?
penguins |> filter(body_mass < 3500 & bill_len < 35) |> count()
```
